tests: same requestId+payload after lost response or process restart returns the same 8hex id without a second native pending
same requestId with a different payload conflicts and never silently opens a new proposal
retry after a verified final approve/reject receipt returns the existing id and does not recreate pending
published journal with missing pending and no matching signed decision receipt is recovery-required, not restage permission
valid published journal is never rewritten to prepared
new add/replace/remove/batch proposals dry-run under target lock + fresh config and return {version:1,id,reviewLocation} only
replace keeps the exact selected old_text; empty, untrimmed, default target, new_text aliases, summary/path/approval/identity fields are refused
text with lone surrogates, C0 other than TAB/LF/CR, C1, bidi, or ENTRY_DELIMITER is blocked; native _reject_new_text/_norm_payload still apply to new content
scope_id must be exact 64 lower hex; requestId must match the 1-64 charset; canonical UTF-8 input over 64KiB is capacity
proposals dir counts every dirent including held, stage, tmp, and unknown orphans; refuse at 2000; no opportunistic cleanup
before a new journal, native pending+reviews _scan_dir/_collect_ids accounting must leave slots for pending+receipt+claims
os._exit after intent: retry reconstructs stage from the signed prepared journal and matching input
os._exit after stage: retry hard-links the fsynced private stage into an absent native path
os._exit after link (nlink=2, two known paths, same inode): recovery unlinks only the stage, never the native name
os._exit after unlink: nlink=1 pending is _safe_read-verified and the published journal is written before success
os._exit after final: retry reads the durable published journal and returns the existing id
third hard link, dangling symlink/reparse, unsafe mode, foreign inode, or stage digest/MAC mismatch stays held/preserved
native FileExistsError / replacement after link is conflict/recovery-required; do not unlink a newer native path
existing pending, receipt, or claim for the derived 8hex prefix is held and never overwritten or replaced
partial .tmp atomic_write files must not clobber a good final stage; leftover tmps count toward capacity
success is not returned from in-memory state: re-read published journal and native pending (or final receipt) from disk
propose does not write MEMORY.md/USER.md; Windows/non-POSIX is unavailable
limits: POSIX/macOS process-crash recovery only; not a power-loss or Windows durability proof (service still refuses Windows)
same-OS-user or admin tampering of private owned state is outside the security guarantee; unsafe paths/modes/links are still refused
review._safe_read stays nlink==1 globally; nlink==2 is admitted only by the pair reader for the two known stage+pending paths
does not mutate native MEMORY.md/USER.md and does not reimplement apply/decide; dry-run uses review._apply_dry only
caller must already import native and hold review._review_lock(ctx); this module must not take that lock or edit Hermes
no raw payload in the metadata journal; no decision digest, reviewDigest, or keys in the propose result
journals are retained after human apply/reject to block replay; missing published pending without a matching signed receipt cannot restage
native stage_write ignores the review lock: publication is filesystem no-clobber hardlink from a complete fsynced private stage, then unlink stage and fsync both dirs
8hex native id is the HMAC key prefix; pending/receipt/claim collisions are held, never overwritten
capacity is all proposals dirents (held and orphans included) plus native pending+review room for listing and later receipt/claim slots
hardlink requires the same filesystem as the profile tree; EXDEV is unavailable, not a copy fallback
atomicity is the prepared-intent then publish sequence; leftover .tmp/orphan files are evidence and may pin capacity until an operator acts
